race.description: Fly Like An Eagle Wa Racing 4yo Westbred E&G Classic (G2)
race.comment: LAZI DAIS (2) resumes from a spell of four-and-a-half months after showing some very good form last campaign, kicking off the prep with five straight wins. Strikes at 50 per cent when fresh and has trialled so should be ready to go and and draws well. CAPTAIN STIRLING (11) drew very wide and worked last start so was far from disgraced when boxing on. Had scored a good win when resuming here prior and should be race fit now. MAJOR DISCO (1) added to a series of top-three results when he drew on the back row and raced wide but boxed on last time. Missed by a nose from this barrier at Listed level prior. Should be competitive. BELLY UP (7) has placed in four of five previous fresh attempts so could make a bright return.
